0022600217.text: The Pacers host the Wizards at 3-8, 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central, with a 0-5 home record and a two-game losing streak. Washington is 4-7, 10th in the East, and on a four-game losing streak. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton, Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy, and Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met in 2026-27, and Indiana lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20, 2026.
